rules.title: cp parse signal
rules.description: Extract LTE/5G signal metrics from periodic 'signal Internal <modem>' reports. Match any modem-identifier (CND, C4D, etc.) — the E300 changes this label between firmware/SIM variants.

rules.title: cp parse client connect
rules.description: Extract new-client IP/MAC and running total client count

rules.title: cp parse gps
rules.description: Extract GPS lat/lng/lock from NCM Location Services events

rules.title: cp parse cell id
rules.description: Extract cellular cell-id transitions for the LTE modem. Matches any modem identifier (CND, C4D, etc).

rules.title: cp parse wan dhcp
rules.description: Extract WAN-side DHCP lease information when the modem renews IP
